title: She's been on top for 1,900 years 🏛️
caption:
No steel. No support. Still on top 🏛️
Tag someone who'd visit Rome 👇
sources: Encyclopaedia Britannica, 'Pantheon' (built under Hadrian c. 118-128 AD; dome 43.3 m; oculus about 8 m; largest unreinforced concrete dome)
Mark R. & Hutchinson P. (1986) 'On the Structure of the Roman Pantheon', The Art Bulletin 68: 24-34 (lighter aggregate higher in the dome, coffers)

Jackson M. D. et al. (2017) 'Phillipsite and Al-tobermorite mineral cements produced through low-temperature water-rock reactions in Roman marine concrete', American Mineralogist (durability of Roman concrete; corrosion of steel reinforcement in modern concrete)
